facts.text: I cook at home four times a week.
I recently made a chicken parmesan with pasta and it turned out quite well.
I want to try another pasta dish.
I like the idea of a creamy sauce for the Creamy Tomato Pasta Bake.
I like the addition of heavy cream because it sounds rich and indulgent.
I want to try making my own garlic bread instead of buying it from the store.
I want to add dried oregano to the garlic butter for extra flavor.
I am thinking of making homemade pasta sauce to go with my Creamy Tomato Pasta Bake.
